tools.name: colorado_license_search
tools.description: Search Colorado professional and business licenses (DORA) by licensee name or exact license number, optionally by city. Returns status, type, expiry and the official verification link.

tools.name: colorado_license_directory
tools.description: Page through Colorado licensees by profession category, license type, status, city or state. Call colorado_license_directory_options first for the valid categories, types and statuses.

tools.name: colorado_license_directory_options
tools.description: The profession categories, license types and statuses accepted by colorado_license_directory.

tools.name: colorado_somb_providers
tools.description: Search the Colorado Sex Offender Management Board approved treatment, evaluation and polygraph provider directory by name, county, city, ZIP, service, practice level, language or specialty.

tools.name: colorado_rules_ask
tools.description: Answer a question from the included Colorado DORA board and program rules, with cited excerpts. Name the profession, board or program in the question.

tools.name: colorado_somb_standards_ask
tools.description: Answer a question from the Colorado SOMB adult or juvenile standards and guidelines, with cited excerpts.
